# From one discharge to a population

## The question turns around

Sessions 01--05 went deeper into one discharge. Session 06 asks:

> Where in operational and MHD-stability space do the reconstructed VEST states lie ---
> and which statements about limits does the evidence support?

A: database $\rightarrow$ summary row $\;\cdot\;$ B: equilibrium $\rightarrow \beta, l_i, q, I_N$ $\;\cdot\;$
C: summary tables $\;\cdot\;$ D: each limit on its plane $\;\cdot\;$ E: solver-derived stability

::: {.notes}
[2 min]

NARRATE:
The session follows the order of the analysis itself: how a row is computed,
what the physics behind each column is, what the tables hold, then each limit
with its source next to the VEST states on its plane, and last the solver verdicts.
Everything runs offline from the vest_tier_a and vest_operational_history
sample collections, whose manifests pin every file's hash.
:::

# A. Computational workflow

## From the database to a summary row

- `open(shot, paths=...)`: read-only, lazy, inside a `with` block --- few leaves of many shots
- `load(shot)`: eager, materialised --- one shot to modify or run codes on
- a **preset** fixes the IDS read, the extractor, the columns, the key and the grain
- `summary(odss=...)` runs the same extractor offline; `attrs["skipped"]` names what failed

::: {.notes}
[4 min]

NARRATE:
Show the VEST data platform schematic. 48224 is skipped by shot_overview because
its sample carries no plasma current; a skipped shot is better than a silent row
of NaN.
:::

## The physics chain inside `equilibrium_global`

| column | formula (`vaft.formula.equilibrium`) |
| --- | --- |
| $W_\mathrm{MHD}$ | `thermal_energy_from_p_V`: $\tfrac32\int p\,dV$ |
| $\beta_t$, $\beta_p$ | `beta_toroidal_from_p_B0`, `beta_poloidal_from_pressure_integral` |
| $\beta_N$ | `beta_normal_from_beta_tor`: $100\,\beta_t a B_0/I_p$ |
| $l_i(3)$ | `li_3_from_Bp2_volume_integral`: $2\int B_p^2 dV/(\mu_0^2 I_p^2 R_0)$ |
| $I_N$ | `normalized_plasma_current`: $I_p/(aB_0)$ |

::: {.notes}
[3 min]

NARRATE:
The extractor recomputes these from the reconstructed profiles with one
definition for every shot, B0 and R0 from vacuum_toroidal_field (R0 = 0.4 m).
:::

# B. Physical workflow

## Recompute a row from its integrals

- 42962, one slice: $\int p\,dV$ over $V(\psi)$, $\int B_p^2\,dV$ on the grid inside the LCFS
- $W$, $\beta_t$, $\beta_p$, $\beta_N$, $I_N$ reproduce the summary exactly; $l_i(3)$ to 0.7 %
- measured $\rightarrow$ reconstructed $\rightarrow$ derived: $\beta_p$ and $l_i$ are a joint inference
- $q_{95}$ is a flux-surface quantity; $q^*$, $q_\mathrm{cyl}$, $I_N$ are algebraic in $I_p, a, \kappa, R, B$

::: {.notes}
[5 min]

NARRATE:
Show plasma_state_provenance and derived_mhd_parameters, then the reduced
pictures: current_profile_shapes (l_i), q_profile_landmarks (q0, qmin, q95, qa),
shaping_family (kappa, delta).
:::

# C. Summary tables

## History, presets and the Tier A population

- archive: 2257 shots, 38000--45767; no date, no `shot_class` --- shot number $\neq$ time
- presets on the samples: one row per shot / EFIT slice / profile slice
- Tier A: 150 states from 32 shots (133 magnetics + 17 electron-kinetic), good or admissible
- stored `li` is $l_i(1)$ and `betap` the boundary-averaged $\beta_p$ ($B_{pa}=\mu_0 I_p/L_{pol}$): DD axes use $l_i(3)$, $\beta_p^{DD}$
- `efit_quality` $\neq$ `selected`; Thomson density on 64/133 states

::: {.notes}
[5 min]

NARRATE:
Five tables, five grains; uniqueness is checked at each one before any join.
The 32 Tier A shots sit in two narrow bands of shot numbers.
:::

# D. Stability limits on the operating space

## Every limit has a kind, a basis and a source

| limit | basis | source | plane |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| $q^* \geq (1+\kappa)/2$ | ideal MHD, analytic | Freidberg 2008 | $q^*$--$I_N$ |
| $q^*_\mathrm{ST} \geq 1$ | ideal MHD, numerical | Menard 2004 | $q^*_\mathrm{cyl}$--$I_N$ |
| $q_{95} \geq 2.1$ | design guideline | ITER 1991 | $q_{95}$--$l_i$ |
| $l_i(3)$--$q_\psi$ | empirical (JET) | Wesson 1989 | $q_\psi$--$l_i(3)$ |
| $l_i$--$q(a)$ | theory (cylinder) | Cheng 1987 | $q(a)$--$l_i$ |
| $\beta_N \approx 2.8$ | ideal MHD, numerical | Troyon 1984 | $\beta_N$--$l_i$, $\beta_T$--$I_N$ |
| $\beta_N \leq 4\,l_i(1)$ | empirical envelope | Strait 1994 | $l_i(1)$ only |
| $\bar n R/B$, $n_G$ | empirical | Murakami 1976, Greenwald 1988, Sykes 2000 | Hugill (ST) |

::: {.notes}
[6 min]

NARRATE:
The notebook reads this table from vaft.formula.boundaries, with the equation
number of each source and the machine class it was derived for. Each limit is
then taken in turn: equation, schematic (internal_external_kink, li_qa, troyon,
hugill / hugill_st), the VEST states on that limit's own plane, and how to read it.
:::

## The planes

- one current (EFIT) and one field convention ($B_T$ at $R_\mathrm{geo}$; $\beta_N\cdot R_\mathrm{geo}/R_0$)
- $q^* I_N = 5\kappa/A$: the $q^*$--$I_N$ plane is mostly shape
- Freidberg: OUTSIDE its calibration; Menard: declared for STs, no tested range
- Wesson and Cheng: reference only (DCON `qlim` sits at $\psi_N = 0.994$)
- the Troyon plane re-expresses $\beta_N$; Hugill is drawn in the ST and the conventional form

::: {.notes}
[5 min]

NARRATE:
Read the applicability line before the boundary. Unless a boundary is
SUPPORTED, it is a reference, not a VEST limit.
:::

# E. Solver-derived stability

## Layers stay separate

- DCON full edge: 129 stable / 13 unstable / 8 unresolved; truncated edge: 146 / 3 / 1
- $\Delta'>0$ raw on most states, QA-supported on 9 (RDCON) and 38 (STRIDE)
- a failed run is not assessed, never a drive; an unresolved $n$ can still carry a raw drive; $\Delta'>0$ is not a tearing verdict
- $D_R>0$ on 124, $D_I>0$ on 1, $C_A<0$ on 12

::: {.notes}
[5 min]

NARRATE:
Schematics first: dcon_rdcon_stability, delta_prime, interchange_criteria.
Join on (shot, EFIT time in microseconds, lineage), one-to-one: 150/0/0. The
edge treatment moves about one state in ten, and most full-edge instabilities
vanish with the truncated edge; report both. Magnitudes are not
growth rates.
:::

## Takeaways

- a summary row is computed: preset, extractor, physics chain, `skipped`
- every column has an integral definition and a normalisation; names are not definitions
- every limit has a kind, a basis, a source and a domain
- envelope $\neq$ limit; boundaries only on their own quantity, with applicability
- ideal, resistive, local and QA are separate layers

::: {.notes}
[2 min]

NARRATE:
End of the course. Regression, similarity, events and learning are optional
extensions on top of a population defined this carefully.
:::
